item.title: Nancy Guthrie abduction clues: Retired homicide sergeant weighs in
item.description: A retired homicide and cold case sergeant is analyzing investigators' "huge break" in the suspected abduction of Nancy Guthrie, who has been missing for nearly two weeks.

item.title: Scientific studies calculate climate change as health danger, while Trump calls it a ‘scam’
item.description: Again and again, research has found increasing disease and deaths in a warming world.

item.title: House renames press gallery after Frederick Douglass in bipartisan recognition of Black history
item.description: The event was attended by prominent Black conservative activists, faith leaders and White House officials.

item.title: Judge grants Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction for extra eligibility
item.description: In saying “the NCAA ignored its own rules,” a Mississippi judge granted Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction Thursday against college athletics’ governing body, allowing him to receive an extra year of eligibility so he can play next season.

item.title: Puerto Rico governor signs law to recognize fetus as human being as critics warn of consequences
item.description: The amendment was approved Thursday without public hearings and amid concerns from opponents.

item.title: Walled Lake Northern’s Hellebuyck backstops US to Olympics-opening win over Latvia 5-1
item.description: Bouncing back from having a pair of goals wiped out by coach’s challenges, the U.S. opened the Olympics by rolling past Latvia 5-1 on Thursday night in a dominant showcase of some of the country’s best NHL players. Brock Nelson scored twice, four players had two assists apiece and there was production up and down the lineup.

item.title: Get the love part right: It’s about knowing each other, sacrifice and sticking around on bad days
item.description: Sometimes, as the songs go, love stinks, love bites and love hurts.

item.title: Justin Verlander explains how he set Tigers homecoming in motion
item.description: Justin Verlander picked up the phone months before the Tigers ever offered him a contract. More than two decades after his Detroit debut, Verlander is back where his career began. This reunion was not accidental. As early as last November, he reached out to owner Chris Ilitch, president Scott Harris and manager A.J. Hinch to make clear he wanted to return.

item.title: West Bloomfield athletic director Eric Pierce honored by MIAAA
item.description: West Bloomfield's Eric Pierce was announced as the recipient of the Michigan Interscholastic Athletic Administrators Association's Region 11 Athletic Director of the Year Award on Wednesday.

item.description: Lakes Area United defeated Walled Lake United 3-1 in the game played on Thursday, Feb. 12, 2026 at the Detroit Skating Club.
